verdict.rationale: Postman ships its own mock servers that simulate a real API and are always available to handle requests (docs-10, docs-25), including dynamic mock responses (docs-36). The Postman CLI can start mock servers and run simulations against local mocks (docs-2, docs-23), so automated or agent-driven tests can target a simulated API instead of production. Environment switching is listed as a feature (docs-47) and a community user confirms testing across environments (comm-20). missing for 10: explicit documentation tying Agent Mode or coding agents to mock/sandbox targets, detailed environment-isolation docs beyond a link, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven sandbox testing.
